rationale: The Evaluator feedback suggests testing a slightly lower base_speed (1.4) to reduce aggressive driving and improve stability, increasing kd to 3.5 to enhance damping of oscillations, and adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0] to increase the influence of inner sensors for better steering precision. I have implemented these changes while keeping kp at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain a balance between responsiveness and integral correction. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. I expect these adjustments to reduce line loss events and steering oscillations, improving overall line-following performance. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects.
